2026-05-01.text:
Rain-free and bright, the morning opened at Hearst Castle before the afternoon pulled us north along the coast to watch elephant seals doze in the sun.

**Highlights:**

- [Neptune Pool](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neptune_Pool) — filled and drained multiple times due to California drought restrictions, it holds 345,000 gallons at capacity and incorporates fragments of a genuine Roman temple
- [Casa Grande, Hearst Castle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hearst_Castle) — architect Julia Morgan and Hearst collaborated for 28 years; the façade's Plateresque carvings were salvaged from Spanish convents
- [Piedras Blancas Elephant Seal Rookery](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Piedras_Blancas_elephant_seal_rookery) — seals only colonized this beach in 1990; the colony now numbers over 17,000 animals annually
- [Brown Pelican](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brown_pelican) — once nearly extinct from DDT exposure, it was removed from the U.S. endangered species list in 2009

2026-05-02.text:
Folk art stump faces at Moonstone Beach gave way to an evening of glowing fiber-optic meadows and geometric light sculptures at Sensorio in Paso Robles.

**Highlights:**

- [Moonstone Beach Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moonstone_Beach) — a narrow coastal strip in Cambria known for beachcombing moonstones; also hosts informal folk art installations tucked into its blufftop vegetation.
- [Sensorio Field of Light](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sensorio) — Bruce Munro's permanent installation uses over 58,000 solar-powered fiber-optic stems across 15 acres of Central Coast ranchland; Munro originally conceived the "Field of Light" concept while camping in Australia's outback in 1992.

2026-05-03.text:
Midday light caught McWay Falls mid-plunge, turquoise water swirling around the cove's sea stacks below the overlook trail. The hazy sky softened the drama only slightly.

**Highlights:**
- [McWay Falls](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McWay_Falls) — one of the few "tidefall" waterfalls in California, it drops 80 feet directly onto a beach that is completely inaccessible to visitors, keeping the sand perpetually undisturbed
- [Julia Pfeiffer Burns State Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julia_Pfeiffer_Burns_State_Park) — named after a Big Sur homesteader, the park extends offshore into a protected marine reserve, making its underwater kelp habitat as regulated as its trails

A wine tasting at what appears to be a boutique winery unfolded over conversation, pistachios, and overcast light filtering through a window framing a massive gnarled tree and barrel-dotted grounds — a golden retriever completing the scene with characteristic indifference.

**Highlights:**

- [Winery Tasting Room](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Winery) — boutique wineries frequently use club membership tiers and structured tasting menus to drive direct-to-consumer sales, bypassing traditional distribution entirely; the "CLUB LEVELS & BENEFITS" booklet visible here reflects an industry model now accounting for over 60% of some small producers' revenue.
